is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and other Anopheles species (page 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for species identification (IGS-rDNA) but does not report genotyping for any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers (e.g., kdr, ace-1, etc.).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report genotype counts or frequencies for any insecticide-resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in two villages in Côte d’Ivoire (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical entomological survey.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Piste 4 (coastal) and Pétessou (inland) villages (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new entomological survey.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any insecticide-resistance marker data, so no supplement is needed for that purpose.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the biting and resting behavior of Anopheles gambiae s.l. in two villages in Côte d’Ivoire in relation to LLIN usage. While it performed species identification using IGS-rDNA, it did not genotype for any insecticide-resistance markers.
